csv_project_name: AE for Various Medina County Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The Medina County Board of Commissioners ( Board ) is seeking Statement of Qualifications from parties interested in providing professional design services for various County projects over the next twelve (12) months (September 1, 2026, through August 31, 2027). Scope of Services The services required may include, but are not limited to: Architectural and engineering design services Construction management Project administration and coordination
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management
title: AE for Various Medina County Projects
short_description: County seeks multidisciplinary design services for various building and civil projects over 12 months.
project_scope: On-call professional design services for various Medina County projects during a 12-month period from September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. The notice does not define specific projects, building types, sizes, spans, gross floor areas, or technical characteristics.
services: Architectural and engineering design services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction management, and project administration and coordination.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style solicitation for various unspecified county projects over 12 months.
- No defined structure, span, building size, or technically demanding scope is provided.
- Includes architecture and civil engineering, but also broad project/construction management components.
- Lacks clear focus on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, sports venues, or major cultural/university buildings.
- According to the guidance, framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice only describes an on-call design services procurement for multiple unspecified county projects over a 12-month period, so no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because the solicitation covers various unspecified projects and no budgets, scopes, or fee basis are provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Statement of Qualifications requested from parties interested in providing professional design services. Disciplines requested include architecture services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and construction/project management. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Medina County Board of Commissioners, Medina, Ohio, USA. Contact: Matthew Springer. Phone: 330-322-5300. Fax: 330-722-9206. Email: mspringer@medinacounty.gov. Website: https://www.medinaco.org/request-for-qualifications-professional-design-services/
notes: This is an RFQ/RFP for various county projects rather than a single defined project. Contract duration is 12 months; renewable: no; stage: RFP/RFQ. Solicitation documents are available online.
